title: Windows Defender / Antivirus Blocking
description: Windows Defender or 3rd party antivirus flags or deletes the loader immediately.
solution:
1. Open Windows Security -> Virus & threat protection.
2. Click 'Manage settings' under Virus & threat protection settings.
3. Turn off Real-time protection, or scroll down to 'Exclusions' and add your Downloads/game folder as an exclusion.
